name: copilot-gateway
description: Wrapper that runs the crispy-copilot-gateway (GitHub Copilot API gateway) locally: on first start it clones the gateway from GitHub into the plugin data dir and installs it (venv + pip; needs git, python>=3.12, one-time network), then serves it on 127.0.0.1:8812 with its own isolated data store. gateway_update pulls the git tree like a manual install would. Composer chip (up/latency, credits + accounts tooltip), side-pane view (accounts, device-flow login, proxy keys + pinning, credits metering, provider config). Fresh machines redo OAuth once.

gateway_path.description: Advanced: use an existing crispy-copilot-gateway checkout instead of the embedded install (empty = embedded)

gateway_repo.description: Git repo the plugin clones the gateway from

git_path.description: Advanced: full path to git.exe when git is outside the standard locations (empty = auto-detect)
